work: title: Old and New Testaments in the Later Version of the Wycliffite Bible
work: standard title(s): Bible (later Wycliffite version) [Middle English]
bibliography: note(s): An apparently unique further revision preceded by chapter 1 of the General Prologue.; Includes 3 Ezra, found otherwise only in the Earlier Version of the Wycliffite Bible MSS, in a lightly revised form. Prologues to Isaiah and Baruch and to the books of the New Testament. In addition to the Later Version of the Wycliffite Bible Prologue to Romans, the Earlier Version of the Wycliffite Bible prologue is included, possibly as an afterthought (see Collation).; Chapter numbers as red Roman numerals with blue paraphs in Old Testament and as alternating red and blue Roman numerals in New Testament. Running titles in red with blue paraphs on both rectos and versos in Old Testament, and in alternating red and blue capitals written across the opening in New Testament. Added material within the text is underlined in black throughout. Omissions added in the margins, often decorated with red penwork; some are in a cursive script with Secretary influence (e.g., fol. 87r–v). Occasionally an addition, originally written in the margin, is erased and entered within the text over an erasure in a contemporary hand (e.g., fol. 93v). There are two glosses in red in the margins in the hand of the original rubricator: Pater noster at Matthew 15 (fol. 303v) and Note þis decree at 1 Ezra 7:25–26 (fol. 137r), marking a passage on the observance of the law of God and the law of the king. Other marginal glosses by the original scribe, linked by sigla to the text. Very few glosses in New Testament. Added (?) note of ymages, fol. 200r, Wisdom 15. Parchment tabs at the beginning of books throughout, apart from some short prophetic books and New Testament epistles. The tabs have short titles of books (e.g., Iudicum) or the opening letters of such titles written on the recto in the hand responsible for most Carthusian additions (see below).; Fifteenth-century additions similar to those found in Latin bibles owned by the Carthusians (Doyle (1998); Hudson, A., ‘The Carthusians and a Wycliffite Bible’, in Kras, P. et al. (eds), Ecclesia, cultura, potestas: studia z dziejów kultury i społeczenstwa (Krakow: Societas Vistulana, 2006), pp. 731–42). Lections during the week for the year are marked in the margins throughout; their opening words are also often marked within the text. Such notation is absent in psalms and much of the four gospels, presumably because other copies of these texts with instructions existed (Hudson, A., ‘The Carthusians and a Wycliffite Bible’, in Kras, P. et al. (eds), Ecclesia, cultura, potestas: studia z dziejów kultury i społeczenstwa (Krakow: Societas Vistulana, 2006), pp. 731–42, p. 737). The markings include marginal letters in red P, S and T (Prima, Secunda and Tertia lectio); the first of these is often followed by an indication of day (e.g., Feria ii, Feria iij, Sabbato) and season (e.g., Dominica in sexagesima, fol. 17v; On passyon Sunday, fol. 229r).; A different set of readings is marked In Refectorio, followed by the number of leaves to be read. Occasionally these are accompanied by further comments in plummet indicating that these longer passages to be read in refectorio were compared with the text in another book, presumably a Latin bible (de Hamel, C., The book: a history of the Bible (London: Phaidon, 2001), pp. 184–5; Hudson, A., ‘The Carthusians and a Wycliffite Bible’, in Kras, P. et al. (eds), Ecclesia, cultura, potestas: studia z dziejów kultury i społeczenstwa (Krakow: Societas Vistulana, 2006), pp. 731–42, p. 738; Dove, M., The first English Bible: the text and context of the Wycliffite versions (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2007), p. 65): In Refectorio iiij ff in alio libro xiiij et dimidium (fol. 1v) In Refectorio iij ff in alio libro x ff et dimidium (fol. 18r) In Refectorio iiij fol in alio libro xiij ff (fol. 31r) In Refectorio xix ffoliis et dimidium (fol. 116r) In Refectorio xij folia (fol. 135v) In refectorio iij fol of þis boke (right margin) and [or et] ix fol of þe latyn B… (lower margin; the rest is cut off; fol. 159r) In Refectorio v ff (fol. 229v) In Refectorio iiij fol et dimidium (fol. 239v) In Refectorio vi et dimidium fol (fol. 265v) In Refectorio (fols. 332r and 332v) Dominica in Refectorio ii folia (fol. 371r). ; The notes suggest that the Latin book was much smaller than MS. Bodl. 277, presumably a portable ‘Parisian’ bible: four leaves in MS. Bodl. 277 correspond once to 14½ leaves in ‘another book’ and to 13 leaves on the second occasion. Several notes suggest that the text was indeed compared to a Bible, e.g., a note about omitted names of towns in Joshua 15:33 (fol. 66v); þe prologe wantyth at the beginning of Jeremiah (fol. 229r) and prologus car’ at the beginning of Ezekiel (fol. 249v). Other notes include Cantatur in Choro at the beginning of the psalter (fol. 167r); turne to þe boke Ieremie & leve & leve þe boke of kynges for þat is next after ebre vse at the beginning of 1 Kings (fol. 78v; see Hudson, A., ‘The Carthusians and a Wycliffite Bible’, in Kras, P. et al. (eds), Ecclesia, cultura, potestas: studia z dziejów kultury i społeczenstwa (Krakow: Societas Vistulana, 2006), pp. 731–42, p. 737); id est canonicum added to a rubric introducing Canonical epistles (fol. 365v), and Odyr wyse callyd Epistole Canonicales (fol. 366r).; Marginal divisions A–H, found in other Carthusian bibles combined with primo, secundo and tertio, appear in many parts of the text (Saenger (2005), p. 92 n. 71). Unlike the indexing letters they run across chapters and again suggest that the text was compared with a Latin bible. They often (though not always) start at the beginnings of books, and if a prologue is present, A is used to mark the prologue, whereas B corresponds to the beginning of the first chapter in a book (e.g., Canonical epistles, fol. 365v). If a prologue is not included, A is missing and B appears at the beginning of the first chapter (e.g., Genesis, Joshua, I Kings, Tobit, Judith, Esther, Job). At the beginning of Ezechiel (fol. 249v) a note about a missing prologue is accompanied by A, whereas B corresponds to the beginning of the first chapter. In books that do not have a prologue A tends to appear at the start of the book (e.g., Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Judges, 2 Kings, 3 Kings). Occasionally the subdivisions are accompanied by comments which suggest comparison to another manuscript, such as capitulum vij (fol. 194v) at subdivision ‘G’ marking What nede is it to a man… which appears at the beginning of Ecclesiastes 7 in the Earlier Version of the Wycliffite Bible, but belongs to the end of chapter 6 in the Later Version of the Wycliffite Bible. On fol. 294v the subdivision ‘E’ is accompanied by a note ii columna; on fol. 195v ‘G’ is accompanied by vi and on fol. 198r another ‘G’ is marked capitulum viij.; [quires I–XXV]; [quires XXVI–XXXI]

language: text lang(s): Latin including a very little Old English
bibliography: note(s): As ed. R. R. Darlington and P. McGurk (Oxford Medieval Texts). Formerly attributed to 'Florence of Worcester', and forming a continuation to the Chronicon of Marianus Scotus.

Preceded (Darlington and McGurk, II, pp. xlvi-l) by lists and tables of Roman consuls, popes, English bishops and archbishops, genealogies of Anglo-Saxon royal dynasties, computistical texts and tables (pp. 48–65), a text of Bede, De locis sanctis (pp. 66–70), a text on the measurements of the cross (p. 71), and a genealogy of French kings and Norman dukes, as in Oxford, Corpus Christi College, MS. 157, from which the present manuscript was copied.

Substantial contemporary marginal additions, and interpolations in the text, drawing on a range of sources (including extracts from Eadmer, Historia Novorum), some relating to Bury St. Edmunds Abbey: printed and discussed in Darlington and McGurk, II, appendix B, and III, appendix B. Additions on pp. 281–2 (Cuthbert's Epistola de obitu Bedae, including Bede's Death Song) and pp. 328–9 (Bury charter) include Old English.
Followed (p. 423b) by extracts from the Chronicle of Jocelyn of Brakelond, added early thirteenth century (pr. Darlington and McGurk, III, pp. 323–6).

Entries for New Testament readings consist of the name of the liturgical occasion in red, abbreviated reference to a book and chapter of the New Testament, an indexing letter in red, the opening words of a reading, ende in red, the closing words of a reading and double strokes in red. Includes feasts characteristic of the Later Version of the Wycliffite Bible (Forshall, J. and Madden, F. (eds), The Holy Bible … in the earliest English versions made from the Latin Vulgate by John Wycliffe and his followers, 4 vols (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1850), vol. 4, pp. 683, 690–6), apart from Giles (1 September). Some Old Testament readings derive from the Earlier Version of the Wycliffite Bible (e.g., Ecclesiasticus 24, Genesis 24), whereas other from the Later Version of the Wycliffite Bible (e.g., Jeremiah 14, Jeremiah 23, Ecclesiasticus 44) (see MS. Douce 265-a).; Includes the temporal, followed by commemorations and the sanctoral. The temporal is imperfect because of the loss of leaves after fol. 2: missing readings from Saturday of the third week in Advent to Friday of the fourth week after the octave of Epiphany. Commemorations are in the following order: the Virgin Mary, Trinity, Holy Ghost, Cross, Angels, of briþeren & sistris & salus populi, peace, clear weather, rain, In time of batels, A man for him silf, ffor deeþ of bestis, pilgrims, weddings, sinners, sick, Pistils at masse of requiem, Gospels at masse of requiem. The sanctoral is preceded by a rubric, Here enden þe commemoraciouns & bigynneþ þe sancrorum boþe of þe comyne and propre to gidre (fol. 28r).; Running titles in red with blue paraphs, e.g., þe þridde sundai in aduent. work: title: Psalms 1–150 in the Later Version of the Wycliffite Bible
work: standard title(s): Bible, Old Testament, Psalms (later Wycliffite version) [Middle English]
bibliography: note(s): In the biblical order, written as prose, with English titles in red and numbers as part of titles. Latin incipits are written in red in the margins or on lines containing the titles up to fol. 21v, and immediately preceding the English opening words of each psalm afterwards. Psalms 1–43, therefore, have English initials, whereas psalms 44–150 have initials of their Latin incipits. Some incipits have errors (e.g., Domine est terra for Domini est terra, fol. 10v). There are textual divisions at psalms 26, 38, 52, 68, 80, 97 and 109 (see Decoration). Subdivisions within psalms are not indicated, apart from psalm 118, subdivided into twenty-two 8-verse units. The seven Penitential Psalms are marked with Roman numerals in the margins in a medieval hand. Punctuated throughout with punctus used to mark the ends of verses and minor pauses, and punctus elevatus used to mark metrum. Extensive glosses in English in the margins throughout, including glosses on the titles, glosses explaining difficult readings and giving spiritual, moral and literal interpretation of psalms. Some glosses comment on the differences between the Latin and Hebrew texts. The glosses (apart from the title glosses which appear in the margins at the beginning of psalms) are linked to their lemmata by special signs, placed at the beginning of the gloss and above the word on which it comments (red circles with a stroke and similar). Most glosses derive from Nicholas of Lyra’s Postilles, but some from Augustine’s Enarrationes in Psalmos, Jerome and Cassiodorus, often cited through Lyra, as well as from the comun glos or Glossa Ordinaria (Kuczynski (1994), p. 24; Dove, M., The first English Bible: the text and context of the Wycliffite versions (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2007), p. 161 n. 144). The sources of most glosses are stated at their end (e.g., lire here, austin here in red ink). MS. Bodl. 554 preserves the Wycliffite psalter glosses better than any other manuscript (Dove, M., The first English Bible: the text and context of the Wycliffite versions (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2007), p. 161). Most the Later Version of the Wycliffite Bible manuscripts include title glosses (that serve as prologues of psalms) as far as psalm 72, and a few include such glosses afterwards; MS. Bodl. 554 includes such glosses for all psalms (Dove, M., The first English Bible: the text and context of the Wycliffite versions (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2007), p. 156).

bibliography: note(s): A treatise compiled (from Petrus de Abano and other sources) for the solace of Richard II (whose picture is on fol. 9) in March 1391. In the pref. the author calls himself 'minimus servientum' Regis. The account of it on fol. 90 distinguishes three parts 'Liber judiciorum cum duobus alphabetis questionum [fol. 11] & figurarum [fol. 15v]', 'Flores questionum veritatis et judiciorum Geomancie' [fol. 76], and 'Rosarium Regis Ricardi de figuris affirmantibus & prohibentibus effectum querentis & rei quesite cum certificacione hore planete sub quo questiones calculari debent'. On fols. 15v-22v are fourteen figures of philosophers. The whole treatise is partly astrological, and the present MS. may well be the one written for the King. A nearly erased note on the inner front cover refers to Petrus de Abano, and a printed edition of his work on geomancy.

This is a continuous series of ten interconnected rhythmical poems on various religious and moral themes; although each poem begins with a 2-space initial, the sense is more or less continuous. The rhythms are: (i) 3 (7pp 6p) rhyming ababab; (ii)–(vii) various combinations of 8p and 6p: e.g., 4 (8p) 1 (6p) 3 (8p) 1 (6p) – 4p4p is often substituted for 8p; (viii)–(ix) 2 (8p) 1 (7p) 2 (8p) 1 (7p), rhyming aabaab or aabccb, with the substitution of 4p4p as in the preceding poems; (x) 2 or 4 (8p), rhyming in couplets or quatrains.; The first and sixth leaves are missing from quire ix: the last three lines of poem (ii) are squeezed into two lines of text, and the next leaf is missing; poem (iii) begins in the middle of a stanza; poem (x) ends in the middle of a stanza.

bibliography: note(s): [item 1 occupies quire I]; The entries consist of the name of the liturgical occasion in red, abbreviated reference to a book and chapter of the Bible, an indexing letter in red, the opening words of a reading, ende in red, the closing words of a reading and double strokes in red. Includes the temporal, commemorations and the sanctoral, both the proper and common according to the rubric, but only the proper is present. Includes all feasts characteristic of the Later Version of the Wycliffite Bible (Forshall, J. and Madden, F. (eds), The Holy Bible … in the earliest English versions made from the Latin Vulgate by John Wycliffe and his followers, 4 vols (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1850), vol. 4, pp. 683, 690–6), apart from Giles (1 September). The entries for the following feasts start with larger capitals in blue: Andrew, Nicholas, Conception of our Lady, Candlemas, Annunciation, the Finding of the Cross, Nativity of John the Baptist, James, Assumption, Nativity of our Lady, Matthew, Michaelmas, Simon and Jude, and Halloween. Commemorations are in the following order: the Virgin Mary, Trinity, Holy Ghost, Cross, angels, ffor briþeren & sistren & salus populi, peace, clear weather, rain, In tyme of batel, A man for him silf, ffor pestilens of beests, pilgrims, weddings, sinners, sick, pistils ffor dede, gospels for the dead. bibliography: note(s): The temporal is followed by the proper (fol. 257r), the common (fol. 261v), and commemorations (fol. 265r). Each reading is preceded by a rubric, stating the liturgical occasion, and giving the title of the biblical book and a chapter number. Indexing letters are entered in the margins at the beginning of readings.; The readings start with introductory statements that precede them at Mass (e.g., The lord god seiþ þese þingis, fol. 228r) underlined in red. The readings used for more than one occasion are not repeated and instead the rubrics contain cross-references, e.g., Seke it on S Siluestir day (fol. 263r). The reading for the first Mass on Christmas morning is preceded by a rubric explaining that it is performed by two voices: On cristemasse morewe þe firste lessoun at þe firste masse þe whiche lesson is sungun in þe pulput þe firste vers and þe laste of two to gidre but alle þe myddil vers oon syngiþ oon and anoþer syngiþ anoþer þe firste vers of þo þat ben sungen bi hemsilf is of þe tixte of Isaye þe profete and þe answere is as it were a glose of þe tixte / and so it is bi & bi þorȝout þe lessoun of whiche þis is þe first vers þat is sungen of boþe to gidre Isaye ixº (fol. 230v). In a passage that follows the part of one of the voices is underlining in red.; Running titles in black with red or blue paraphs on fols. 227r–236r, containing the names of liturgical seasons, e.g., Advent, Cristmasse, ffirste woke of lente. Added material within the text is underlined in red; no marginal glosses. Fols. 226v–228v are ruled but originally blank.

paratext: incipit: Duo ex discipulis Jesu ibant ipsa die in castellum In exordio huius lectionis solet movere nonnullos ad querendum
paratext: explicit: Sed etiam ut mentem eius que in passione titubaverat reformaret.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Surgens paulus et manu silentium indicens ait Omnes quibus iste loquebatur apostolus secundum carnem filii abrahe
paratext: explicit: Eadem vobis fidelis sponsor implebo Christum scilicet de eius styrpe nasciturum. Jesus Christus dominus noster qui vivit.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Stetit Jesus in medio discipulo [sic!] suorum Herent sibi divine lectiones et frequenter una pendet ex altera ita ut non numquam exordia
paratext: explicit: Nolo mortem peccatoris sed ut convertatur et vivat.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Aperiens petrus os suum dixit viri israelite Notandum quod viros de genere israel et timentes deum
paratext: explicit: Neque ad gloriam quam cum Christo habere cupiunt per passiones tribulationum desiderant attingere.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Manifestavit se Jesus ad mare tyberiadis manifestavit autem sic Cum memoriam dominice resurrectionis semper animo retinere
paratext: explicit: Tercio vero quando piscantibus a mare tyberiadis septima vice apparuit discipuli

work: standard title(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819: Collectiones epistolarum et evangeliorum de tempore et de sanctis, siue Expositio libri comitis [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819
paratext: incipit: Angelus domini locutus est ad philippum dicens surge et vade Bene in meridie queritur et invenietur et abluitur ille qui devotione pectoris
paratext: explicit: Ituria civitas libye que est provincie asye. Thesalonica civitas macedonie

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Maria stabat ad monumentum foris plorans In multis locis scripture virtus perseverancie laudabilis ostenditur
paratext: explicit: aliis nunciare debet iuxta quod in apocalipsi legitur qui audit dicat veni.

work: standard title(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819: Collectiones epistolarum et evangeliorum de tempore et de sanctis, siue Expositio libri comitis [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819
paratext: incipit: Karissimi, Christus semel pro peccatis nostris mortuus est. Semel autem dixit quia Christus resurgens a mortuis iam non moriturus
paratext: explicit: Ascendit in celum sedet in dexteram dei que sessio equalitatem potestatis eius cum patre significare.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Undecim discipuli abierunt in galileam in montem Domini visionem [sic!] obedientia comitatur discipulorum
paratext: explicit: Predicabitur hoc evangelium omnibus gentibus et tunc veniet finis.

work: standard title(s): Augustine, Saint, Bishop of Hippo: Sermons [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Deponentes omnem malitiam et omnem dolum et simulationes Omnium quidem aures et mentes quos cura nostra complectitur solliciti pastoris
paratext: explicit: servire iusticie in sanctificationem per dominum nostrum Jesum Christum filium eius qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: bibl: In die octavarum infantium: quos exhortatur verbis Petri apostoli, Deposita ergo omni malitia, etc (PL 39.1560-1563)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Una sabbati maria magdalene venit mane cum adhuc tenebre essent Si quis huius mulieris praeteritas actiones cum praesenti lectione conferat
paratext: explicit: et alios discere volentes reprehendunt solumque in aliis invident quod aut agere non possunt aut nolunt.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi omne quod natum est ex deo vincit mundum Audistis in epistola cum legeretur fratres karissimi iohannem apostolum
paratext: explicit: sic obedientibus eterna vita dabitur et eterna leticia. Per Jesum Christum dominum nostrum qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Cum esset sero die illo una sabbatorum et fores essent clause ubi erant discipuli Quotiens legimus discipulos in domini passione timuisse et post eius resurrectionem
paratext: explicit: Sicut ipse alibi ait hec est autem vita eterna ut cognoscant te solum verum deum et quem misisti Jesum Christum.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi Christus passus est pro nobis vobis relinquens exemplum Fratres karissimi in lectione apostolica quam audistis beatus petrus christianos
paratext: explicit: Promissor et largitor Jesus Christus dominus noster qui vivit et regnat cum patre et spiritu sancto deus per omnia secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: bibl: Dominica secunda post pascha, Misericordia Domini (PL 118.498C-499D)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis ego sum pastor bonus Superius textus evangelii narrat qualiter dominus inter bonos malosque pastores
paratext: explicit: Eratis enim aliquando sicut oves errantes sed conversi estis nunc ad pastorem et episcopum animarum vestrarum.
bibliography: bibl: Dominica secunda post pascha, Misericordia Domini (PL 118.499D-506A)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi obsecro vos tanquam advenas et peregrinos abstinere vos Pulchre satis ammonet et exortatus nos apostolus petrus fratres karissimi
paratext: explicit: ut perpetuam a domino mercedem accipiat. Ipso largiente qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis modicum et iam non videbitis me Modicum et non videbitis me mortalem corruptibilem comprehensibilem sicut nunc
paratext: explicit: qui redempti fuerint a domino et venient in syon letantes et leticia sempiterna super capita eorum.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi omne datum optimum et omne donum perfectum desursum est Et generaliter de omnibus hoc et specialiter de una queque a deo
paratext: explicit: et deus erat verbum. Qui et salvator dicitur quia potest salvare animas vestras

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis vado ad eum qui misit me Frequenter ab initio sue praedicationis dominus discipulos se diligere ostendit
paratext: explicit: quia de me accipiet et adnuntiabit vobis id est nota ea faciet.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi estote factores verbi et non auditores tantum fallentes Verba divina factis nos adimplere si ad celestia regna volumus
paratext: explicit: Sed sua potius sollicitudine et cura diligenti vitam et salutem mereantur eternam.
bibliography: bibl: Dominica quinta post pascha, Vocem iucunditatis (PL 118.520D-522C)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis amen amen dico vobis si quid petieritis patrem Largitor virtutum et remunerator meritorum dominus Jesus Christus
paratext: explicit: acceptum coram salvator nostro deo qui omnes homines vult salvos fieri et ad agnitionem veritatis venire.
bibliography: bibl: Dominica quinta post pascha, Vocem iucunditatis (PL 118.522C-527C); Homilia XC. De litaniis, id est de supplicationibus de exordio earum (PL 118.527C-528D)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi confitemini alterutrum peccata vestra et orate pro invicem Ad optimum salutis nostre remedium hortatur nos apostolus iacobus
paratext: explicit: restringent eterni ignis incendia. Largiente domino nostro Jesu Christo qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: bibl: Feria secunda post vocem iucunditatis, in litaniis maioribus (PL 118.529A-530C)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis quis vestrum habebit amicum et ibit ad illum media nocte Sciens dominus Jesus Christus post amissionem liberi arbitrium
paratext: explicit: alii discretio spirituum. Hec autem omnia operatur unus atque idem spiritus. Dividens singulis prout vult.
bibliography: bibl: Feria secunda post vocem iucunditatis, in litaniis maioribus (PL 118.530D-534C)

work: standard title(s): Ambrosiaster: Commentary on the Epistles of St Paul [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissime obescro igitur primum omnium fieri obsectationes orationes postulationes Hec regula ecclesiastica est tradita a magistro gentium qua utuntur sacerdotes nostri
paratext: explicit: que spes esset in Christo. Hic enim datus est magister ut fidem doceret et veritatem.
bibliography: bibl: In epistolam b. Pauli ad Timotheum I, cap. II (PL 17.465D-467C) = Atto of Vercelli, Epistola I ad Timotheum (PL 134.667D-669C)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis petite et dabitur vobis Poterat aliquis ex auditoribus domino dicere
paratext: explicit: que ieiunando et elemosynas faciendo promeretur eterni regni consortium.
bibliography: bibl: Feria tertia litaniarum, post vocem iucunditatis (PL 118.534C-536C)

work: standard title(s): Rabanus Maurus, Archbishop of Mainz, 784?–856: Homiliae in Evangelia et Epistolas [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres unicuique nostrum data est gratia secundum mensuram donationis [Grat]iam et misericordiam domini nostri Jesu Christi quam generi contulit humano
paratext: explicit: vitam etiam nos ad ipsum possimus accedere. Cui est honor et gloria per infinita seculorum secula. Amen.
bibliography: bibl: In vigilia ascensionis Domini, Lectio epistolae ad Ephesios (PL 110.226C-228A)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Sublevatis Jesus oculis in celum dixit pater venit hora Potuit silenter hec eadem verba orationis pater filius dicere
paratext: explicit: altitudinem celorum et omnium angelicarum potestatum dignitates ita ut in dextera dei patris collocaretur.
bibliography: bibl: Feria QUARTA LITANIARUM, IN VIGILIIS ASCENSIONIS DOMINI (PL 118.536C-540A)

work: standard title(s): Leo, I, Pope, –461: Sermones siue Tractatus [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Post beatam et gloriosam ascensionem domini Jesu Christi qua dei templum
paratext: explicit: eos sibi concorporatus dei filius ad patris dexteram collocavit. Qui vivit et regnat cum deo patre omnipotente et spiritu sancto in secula seculorum. Amen.

work: standard title(s): Rabanus Maurus, Archbishop of Mainz, 784?–856: Homiliae in Evangelia et Epistolas [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Primum quidem sermonem feci de omnibus o thefile que cepit Jesus facere Lucas evangelista fratres karissimi qui unum ex quattuor evangeliis scripsit
paratext: explicit: glorificemus et portemus deum in corpore nostro ut ad ea que fidelibus sunt praemia praeparata pervenire mereamur.
bibliography: bibl: In die ascensionis Domini. Lectio Actuum apostolorum (PL 110.231C-233B)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Recumbentibus undecim discipulis apparuit illis Jesus Ascensurus in celum dominus et per corporalem praesentiam a discipulis
paratext: explicit: Illum bonum doctorem imitans de quo scriptum est. Cepit Jesus facere et docere.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi estote prudentes et vigilate in orationibus Apostolica nos verba fratres karissimi considerare oportet quibus in praesenti audivimus lectione
paratext: explicit: Non ergo in fletibus non in actibus nostris sed in advocati nostri allevatione confidamus. Qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis cum venerit paraclitus quem ego mittam vobis a patre In multis locis evangelii legimus quod ea que minus apostoli perfectionis habebant
paratext: explicit: Gaudete in illa die et exultate quoniam merces vestra copiosa est in celis.

work: standard title(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819: Collectiones epistolarum et evangeliorum de tempore et de sanctis, siue Expositio libri comitis [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819
paratext: incipit: Factum est cum appollo esset corinthi et paulus peragratis superioribus partibus veniret Cum ecclesie regula sit fideles in nomine sancte trinitatis baptizare queritur quomodo lucas per totum libelli
paratext: explicit: credat quis eos tantummodo qui in unitate ecclesie catholice atque apostolice communicent implere.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis si diligitis me mandata mea servate. Quid est quod dicit quod diligentibus deum et servantibus mandata eius
paratext: explicit: Solis vero iustis et sanctis divinitatis gloriam in qua equalis est patri et spiritui sancto ad eternam beatitudinem manifestaturus erit.

work: standard title(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819: Collectiones epistolarum et evangeliorum de tempore et de sanctis, siue Expositio libri comitis [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819
paratext: incipit: Cum complerentur dies pentecostes erant omnes discipuli pariter in eodem loco
paratext: explicit: et qui ex diverso orbe convenerant verum et hii qui de praeputio nati sunt huc venisse perhibentur.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis siquis diligit me sermonem meum servabit. Promissurus dominus spiritum sanctum discipulis quales se exibere debeant
paratext: explicit: Si autem sit christianus non erubescat sed glorificet deum in isto nomine.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis sic deus dilexit mundum ut filium suum ungenitum daret Unde notandum quod eadem de filio dei unigenito replicat que de filio hominis in cruce exaltato promiserat
paratext: explicit: retorquet tibi illud deus ante oculos tuos et tunc retorquebit quando iam iam penitencie fructus nullus erit.

work: standard title(s): Bede, the Venerable, pseudo: Commentary on John [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis amen amen dico vobis qui non intrat per ostium in ovile Propter phariseorum qui se videre iactabant cum ceci erant venenatam et superbam
paratext: explicit: Tamen vere pascua invenient ubi saturentur qui esuriunt et sitiunt iusticiam.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Stans petrus cum undecim elevavit vocem suam et locutus est eis Post adventum spiritus sancti in apostolos quem adhuc praesenti festivitate celebramus.
paratext: explicit: ad celestia non dubitent praeparari. Per dominum nostrum Jesum Christum filium cui est honor et gloria in secula seculorum amen.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus turbis iudeorum nemo potest venire ad me non pater qui misit me Quid est nemo potest venire ad me nisi quia nemo potest credere in me nisi pater qui misit me
paratext: explicit: Non sit putridum menbrum quod resecari meratur sit pulcrum sit sanum sit aptum capiti suo.

work: standard title(s): Rabanus Maurus, Archbishop of Mainz, 784?–856: Homiliae in Evangelia et Epistolas [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Convocatis Jesus duodecim apostolis dedit illis virtutem et potestatem super omnia Concessa primum potestate signorum misit praedicare regnum dei
paratext: explicit: Regni enim celorum ianuis propinquare est de hiis quemque quibus ab eo discesserat penitere.
bibliography: bibl: Feria quinta pentecostes. Lectio sancti Evangelii secundum Lucam (PL 110.271C-273C)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus turbis si ego in spiritu dei eicio demones Ecce hic trinitas videtur. Trinitas appellata quod fiat totum unum.
paratext: explicit: Nemo dominum Jesum intellectu cernit nemo voluntate amplectitur nisi per gratiam spiritus sancti.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Surgens Jesus de synagoga introivit in domum symonis Cum venisset Jesus in domum petri vidit socrum eius iacentem
paratext: explicit: Ibique in suis fidelibus orabat quia corda eorum per gratiam sui spiritus ad virtutem orationis excitabat.

work: standard title(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819: Collectiones epistolarum et evangeliorum de tempore et de sanctis, siue Expositio libri comitis [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819
paratext: incipit: Vidi hostium apertum in celo. Convenienter hostium celeste ascensurus aspicit
paratext: explicit: ante thronum deo videlicet adsignantes quicquid virtutis quicquid habebant digitatis quippe qui ex nichilo cuncta creavit.
bibliography: bibl: Lectio libri Apocalypsis Ioannis apostoli, cap. IV (PL 102.334A-339A)

work: standard title(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819: Collectiones epistolarum et evangeliorum de tempore et de sanctis, siue Expositio libri comitis [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819
paratext: incipit: Vidi ostium apertum in celo id est fidem nativitatis Christi et passionis et resurrectionis in ecclesia
paratext: explicit: et ei referunt gloriam laudis a quo se cognoscunt vires accepisse certaminis.
bibliography: bibl: Lectio libri Apocalypsis b. Ioannis apostoli, cap. IV (PL 102.332A-334A)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Erat homo ex phariseis nichodemus nomine princeps iudeorum Sicut unius ignorantia aliquando multis obesse solet sic unius interrogatio multis prodess
paratext: explicit: Et iterum tu credis quod unus sit deus bene facis et demones credunt et contremiscunt.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi deus caritas est. In hoc apparuit caritas dei in nobis quem filium suum unigenitum misit in mundum
paratext: explicit: Sed vide inquid quia mandata tua dilexi domine. Et ideo confidenter adiungit in tua misericordia vivifica me.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis parabolam hanc homo quidam erat dives et induebatur Scriptura sacra divinitus inspirata non solum bonorum actiones ad imitandum commemorat
paratext: explicit: Unde salvator ait in evangelio si crederetis moysi crederetis forsitan et mihi. De me enim ille scripsit.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi nolite mirari si odit vos mundus. Nec mirandum quia qui amant mundum fratrem a mundi amore
paratext: explicit: Patet quia ex veritate sumus que deus est utpote qui eius perfectionem pro modulo nostro imitamur.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis similitudinem hanc homo quidam fecit cenam magnam Omnipotens deus in exordio mundane formationis ad se cognoscendum seque perpetualiter laudandum
paratext: explicit: caritas dei est indutos introducere dignetur qui vivit et cum quo vivunt omnes qui ingrediuntur ille cum filio et spiritu sancto illi cum gaudio sempiterno in secula seculorum amen.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi humiliamini sub potenti manu dei ut vos exaltet in tempore visitationis Modo fratres karissimi audivimus beatum petrum apostolum ad humilitatem nos cohortantem atque dicentem
paratext: explicit: In sua semper voluntate et in divina religione confirmet et corroboret in perseverentia bonarum operum.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Erant adpropinquantes ad Jesum publicani et peccatores ut audirent illum Sicut unius peccatoris casus multos ad desperationem trahere solet
paratext: explicit: Quia sicut ait salvator in praesenti lectione gaudium erit in celo super uno peccatore penitentiam agente.

work: standard title(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819: Collectiones epistolarum et evangeliorum de tempore et de sanctis, siue Expositio libri comitis [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819
paratext: incipit: Fratres existimo enim quod non sunt condigne passiones huius temporis Si quis intueatur quod pro eo namque efficiatur filius excelsi dei et heres bonitatis eius et glorie
paratext: explicit: quia necdum tenemus sed in spe salvi facti sumus quamvis que multi cupierunt iusti videre viderimus.
bibliography: bibl: Lectio epistolae b. Pauli apostoli ad Romanos, cap. VIII (PL 363A-367B)

work: standard title(s): Rabanus Maurus, Archbishop of Mainz, 784?–856: Homiliae in Evangelia et Epistolas [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres existimo enim quod non sunt condigne passiones huius temporis Quod ad comparationem eterne glorie quam sanctis suis deus ante secula praeparavit
paratext: explicit: dignetur in nobis non solum custodire sed etiam augere munera vel beneficia sua que ipse dignatus est dare.
bibliography: bibl: Dominica quinta post pentecosten. Lectio Epistolae ad Romanos (PL 110.333A-334D)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis estote misericordes sicut et pater vester misericors est Inter ceteras virtutes quibus dominus Jesus Christus celestem gloriam querere monuit
paratext: explicit: qui exiit a pharaone iratus nimis quia eius nequitiam incorrigibilem vidit.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Karissimi omnes unanimes in oratione estote Fraternitatis unanimitas veluti urbs inexpugnabilis
paratext: explicit: caritate credendo colendo et adorando ut ab illo salvari pariter mereamur et sanctificari.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Cum irruerent ad Jesum ut audirent verbum dei De piscibus quos apostoli ad iussionem domini laxato reti ceperunt
paratext: explicit: relictis omnibus et recibus secuti sunt illum ita ut ulterius ad propheta non redirent.

work: title: In epistolam ad Romanos, cap. VI
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Quicumque baptizati sumus in Christo Jesu in morte ipsius baptizati sumus Beatus apostolus mystice et subtilissime isto in loco loquitur et vult ostendere
paratext: explicit: id est sapientie prudentie castitati ceterisque virtutibus quicumque enim deo vivit omnibus virtutibus vivit que in deo sunt.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis amen dico vobis nisi habundaverit iusticia vestra Qui putant praecepta veteris testamenti districtiora esse quam novi
paratext: explicit: Lignum inquam cumque partem ceciderit sive ad austrum sive ad aquilonem id est sive in infernum sive in regnum dei ibi erit.

work: title: In epistolam ad Romanos, cap. VI
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres humanum dico propter infirmitatem carnis vestre Quid est quod dicit apostolus humanum dico hoc est leve et ad complendum facile
paratext: explicit: gratis vitam eternam per adiutorium Jesu Christi sine quo nichil boni habere possimus.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Cum turba multa esset cum Jesu nec haberent quod mandcarent Dominus Jesus Christus deus ante secula et homo factus in fine seculorum
paratext: explicit: sanctus sanctus sanctus dominus deus sabaoth qui est et qui erat et qui venturus est.

work: standard title(s): Rabanus Maurus, Archbishop of Mainz, 784?–856: Homiliae in Evangelia et Epistolas [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres debitores sumus non carni ut secundum carnem vivamus Apertissime nos beatus apostolus fratres karissimi in praesenti lectione quam audisti[s]
paratext: explicit: non solum in partem hereditatis sed etiam in consortium beatitudinis perducit.
bibliography: bibl: Hebdomada IX post pentecosten. Lectio epistolae b. Pauli ad Romanos (PL 110.384B-386A)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis adtendite a falsis prophetis qui veniunt ad vos Previdens dominus doctrinam hereticorum contra electos in ecclesia futuram
paratext: explicit: et custodiunt illud. Et iterum discipulis suis scitis hec beati eritis si feceritis ea.

work: title: In epistolam I ad Corinthios, cap. X
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres non simus concupiscentes malorum sub auditur cyborum et vitiorum
paratext: explicit: ut ipse nobis faciat perventum evenire citius liberando aut etiam victorie tolerantiam prebendo.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis homo quidam erat dives qui habebat villicum Usus sacre scripture est ut aliquando iuxta litteram sic quedam facta commemoret
paratext: explicit: optinuit ad praedicandum fidem quam prius persecutus fuerat in diversas nationes destinavit.

work: title: In epistolam I ad Corinthios, cap. XII
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Scitis quoniam cum gentes essetis Reducitur ab apostolo corinthiis vite pristine conversatio in noticiam
paratext: explicit: quia in separabilis est eorum operatio. Dividens singulis electorum dona sua non tamen ipse divisus et prout vult quia omnipotens est.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Cum adpropinquaret Jesus ierosolymam vidit civitatem flevit super illam In huius lectionis serie dominus Jesus Christus utinamque suam naturam commendat divinam scilicet
paratext: explicit: Ipse enim in templo docet cum exterius per praedicatores doctrinam format et interius cor auditoris illustrat.

work: title: In epistolam I ad Corinthios, cap. XV
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres notum vobis facio id est ad memoriam vobis ad reduco evangelium quod praedicavi vobis
paratext: explicit: Et in hoc quia voluntatem suam iunxit voluntati dei ideo dignus est remuneratione.

paratext: incipit: Fratres notum vobis facio evangelium quod praedicavi vobis quod et accepistis in quo et statis Cum notum facere proprie sit quod antea incognitum erat queritur quomodo dicat apostolus
paratext: explicit: Scio cui credidi et certus sum quia potens est depositum meum servare in illum diem iustus iudex.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis parabolam hanc duo homines ascenderunt in templum In multis locis sacra scriptura quantum virtus humilitatis hominibus prosit.
paratext: explicit: a domino exaltari merantur ad quorum nos consortium perducere digneturille qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum amen.

work: title: In epistolam II ad Corinthios, cap. III
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres fiduciam talem habemus per Christum ad deum In hac lectione vult apostolus differentiam et distantiam facere
paratext: explicit: ut observatores simus evangelii quatinus ab illam gloriam digni simus pertingere quam promittit.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Exiens Jesus de finibus tyri veni per sidonem ad mare galilee Supra retulit evangelica lectio qualiter dominus fines tyri et sydonis adpropinquans
paratext: explicit: et eo amplius admirabantur dicentes. Bene omnia fecit et surdos fecit audire et mutos loqui.

work: title: In epistolam Pauli ad Galatas, cap. III
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres Abrahe dicte sunt promissiones et semini eius. Non dicit singulari numero
paratext: explicit: ipse redimeret et qui per legis opera non eramus digni iustificari ac vivificari per eius fidem optineremus.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis beati oculi qui vident que vos videtis In exordio huius lectionis queritur quare dominus oculos se videntium beatificet
paratext: explicit: omnia bona que potes quibuscumque vales impende et implecti utique caritatem que ad vitam ducit eternam.

work: title: In epistolam Pauli ad Galatas, cap. V
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres spiritu ambulate et desideria carnis non perficiatis De hac lectione diversi doctores non equaliter sentiunt dicentes
paratext: explicit: Et carnem crucifigimus et mortificamus quando delectationi prave et voluntati perverse non consentimus.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dum iret Jesus in ierusalem transibat per mediam samariam et galileam Qui iudee terre confinia novit facile intelligit quod pergens Jesus
paratext: explicit: Teste apostolo qui ait in epistola ad hebreos. Est fides sperandarum substantia rerum argumentum non apparentum.

work: title: In epistolam Pauli ad Galatas, cap. VI
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres si vivimus spiritu spiritu ambulemus Hic de spiritu sancto loquitur. Si inquid vivimus spiritu hoc est si per spiritum sanctum vitam habemus
paratext: explicit: et qui eandem fidem habent et praecipue ad illos qui viam rectitudinis nobis ostendunt verbo et exemplo.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis nemo potest duobus dominis servire Cum ad unius dei culturam dominus Jesus Christus mentes hominum provocaret sciens humanam naturam
paratext: explicit: Hec omnia que adiciuntur tantum in praesenti vita vita esse necessaria id est victum et vestitum.

work: title: In epistolam ad Ephesios, cap. III
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Frates obsecro vos ne deficiatis in tribulationibus meis pro vobis id est ne recedatis a fide Christi
paratext: explicit: id est in praesentes et futuras vel in generationes gentium et generationes iudeorum et in omnia futura seculorum.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Ibat Jesus in civitatem que vocatur naym Mediator dei et hominum Jesus Christus homo pro nobis factus ita in homine quem ex nobis assumpsit
paratext: explicit: in tantum ut obsessum hominem dicerent quid nobis et tibi fili dei venisti ante tempus torquere nos.

work: title: In epistolam ad Ephesios, cap. IV
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres obsecro vos ego vinctus in domino ut digne ambuletis vocatione qua vocati estis Obsecro id est deprecor vos ego vinctus in domino ut digne et sancte vivatis illa vocatione qua vocati estis
paratext: explicit: qui in cordibus fidelum diffusus est et in omnibus creaturis juxta illud spiritus domini replevit orbem terrarum.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Cum intraret Jesus in domum cuiusdam princeps phariseorum sabbato manducare panem Quotiens legimus dominum ad nuptias vel convivium venisse non inlecebris deputare debemus
paratext: explicit: Petro apostolo teste qui ait humiliamini subpotenti manu dei ut vos exaltet in tempore visitationis.

work: standard title(s): Bede, the Venerable, pseudo: Homilies [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Respondens unus de turba dixit ad Jesum magister adtuli filium meum Notandum autem quod semper loca rebus congruunt. In monte dominus orat
paratext: explicit: ratione iuvante domino cunctas antiqui hostis debellabimus ac propulsabimus insidias.
bibliography: bibl: In septembris feria quarta quatuor temporum (PL 94.312C-314D)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dicebat Jesus parabolam hanc ad discipulos suos quem oportet semper orare et non deficere Dixit et apostolus semper gaudete sine intermissione orate quis autem potest ita semper orare
paratext: explicit: Ita ergo et dominus scit quidem omnia per quem facta sunt omnia et tamen dubitando increpat in fidelium corda.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dicebat Jesus turbis similitudinem hanc arborem fici habebat quidam plantatam in vinea sua Potest quidem hec arbor fici generis humani designare naturam. Per vineam genus humanum
paratext: explicit: sed etiam in evangelio declaratur ubi demonia nec in porcos irent nisi hoc illis ipse concederet.

work: title: In epistolam I ad Corinthios, cap. I
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres gratias ago deo meo id est laudes refero deo meo semper pro vobis.
paratext: explicit: In omnibus enim verax apparebit sicut sequentia manifestant fidelis deus per quem vocati estis in societatem filii eius Jesu Christi domini nostri.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Accesserunt ad Jesum saducei qui dicunt non esse resurrectionem Predicante deo nostro Jesu Christo due precipue hereses erant inter iudeos una sadiceorum et altera phariseorum
paratext: explicit: Euge serve bone et fidelis quia super pauca fuisti fidelis super multa te constituam intra in gaudium domini tui.

work: title: In epistolam ad Ephesios, cap. IV
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres renovamini spiritu mentis vestre et induite novum hominem qui secundum deum creatus est Hec verba apostoli ex superioribus pendent. Nam alloquitur ephesum inquiens deponite vos secundum pristinam conversationem
paratext: explicit: non solum debet a furto cessare sed debet operari manibus suis ut habeat unde sustentet alios inopiam patientes.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Ascendens Jesus in naviculam transfretavit et venit in civitatem suam Sepius contingere solet ut una eademque res in scripturis duplicem vel triplicem habeat significantiam
paratext: explicit: Et ut evangelista ait multum rogabant eum demonia ut non eos mitteret in abyssum.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres videte quomodo caute ambuletis non quasi insipientes sed quasi sapientes Alloquitur apostolus ephesyos et in illis omnes hortatur ut caute et considerate vivant
paratext: explicit: non causa adulationis neque patrocinationis quod quidam facunt ut possint invenire gratiam prelati et liberius quod eis delectat operentur.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Loquebatur Jesus cum discipulis suis in parabolis dicens simile factum est regnum Cum frequenter regnum celorum in evangelio nominatur
paratext: explicit: possidete paratum vobis regnum a constitutione mundi quod ipse praestare dignetur qui cum patre et spiritu sancto vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.

work: title: In epistolam ad Ephesios, cap. VI
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres confortamini in domino et in potentia virtutis eius Post specialia praecepta quibus admonuit apostolus viros et mulieres patres et filios
paratext: explicit: possumus superare sed etiam auctoritate illius hereticos convincere et errorem illorum destruere.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Erat quidem regulus cuius filius infirmabatur capharnaum Aliquotiens contingere solet ut nonnulli a qualitate mentis quam habent interius nomina
paratext: explicit: Hic cum magnum signum ostensum esset ipse pater tantum credidit et domus eius tota.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres confidimus in domino Jesu quia qui cepit in vobis opus bonum perficiet usque in diem Sicut mihi iustum est hoc sentire pro omnibus vobis vel iustum est mihi hoc intelligere de vobis
paratext: explicit: Per Jesum Christum in gloriam et laudem dei id est ut glorificetur deus in nobis et laudetur dominus Jesus per quem omnia bona habemus.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis parabolam hanc simile est regnum celorum homini regi qui voluit rationem ponere cum servis suis Virtus et sapientia dei dominus Jesus Christus humane ignorantie condescendens frequenter suis sanctis sermonibus
paratext: explicit: Propter hoc cum dixisset dominus sic et pater meus celestis faciet vobis si non remiseritis unusquisque fratri suo adiunxit de cordibus vestris.

work: title: In epistolam Pauli ad Philippenses, cap. III-IV
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres imitatores mei estote id est me imitamini. Imitatio est cuiuscumque rei quedam ymaginatio et imitari est sequi
paratext: explicit: Iste est liber vite de quo dominus dicit gaudete quod nomina vestra scripta sunt in celo id est in memoria omnipotentis dei.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Abeuntes pharisei consilium inierunt ut caperent Jesum in sermone Ab eo tempore quo totius mundi monarchia sub unius hominis principatu redacta est
paratext: explicit: Sive regi quasi praecellenti sive ducibus tanquam ab eo missis ad vindictam malefactorum laudem vero bonorum.

work: standard title(s): Ambrosiaster: Commentary on the Epistles of St Paul [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Non cessamus pro vobis orantes et postulantes ut impleamini
paratext: explicit: Nam sine fide Christi nullus egressus de inferno est quia obligatus peccatis exire ianuas tartari non potest.
bibliography: bibl: In epistolam b. Pauli ad Colossenses, cap. I (PL 17.421D-422D)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Loquente Jesu ad turbas ecce princeps unus accessit et adoravit eum didicens Inter omnia miracula que dominus Jesus Christus per semetipsum ostendit in terris
paratext: explicit: sed gentilis populus quae erat animalis deinde synagoga que fuit spiritalis.

work: standard title(s): Ambrosiaster: Commentary on the Epistles of St Paul [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres mortificate ergo menbra [sic!] vestra que sunt super terram
paratext: explicit: sicut nunc aque in tantum enim vigebat discipline auctoritas ut subiectum vas non faceret quod volebat.
bibliography: bibl: In epistolam b. Pauli ad Colossenses, cap. III (PL 17.434C-437A)

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Cum sublevasset oculos Jesus et vidisset quia multitudo maxima venit ad eum Quociens legimus dominum ex paucis panibus multas turbas hominum pavisse
paratext: explicit: Confiteamus cum petro quia hic est filiu dei vivi qui propter nos et propter nostram salutem venit in mundum et iterum venturus est iudicare de vivis ac mortuis.
bibliography: bibl: Dominica vigesima sexta post pentecosten (PL 118.741B-C); Homilia XLIX. Dominica quarta in quadragesima sive laetare (PL 118.287A-294B)

work: standard title(s): Maximus, of Turin, Saint, pseudo: Sermons [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Maximus, of Turin, Saint, active 4th century–5th century; Maximus, of Turin, Saint, pseudo
paratext: incipit: Igitur quoniam post tempus spiritalibus epulis reficere nos debemus videamus quid evangelica lectio prosequuntur
paratext: explicit: Tunc enim christianorum beatus populus assumetur in gloriam iudeorum autem exsecrabilis conventus relinquetur in terra.
bibliography: bibl: In dominica prima adventus Domini, recension from Paul the Deacon's Homiliary (PL 95.1160-1161 with PL 57.226A-228B)

bibliography: note(s): Blank page.

work: standard title(s): Ambrosiaster: Commentary on the Epistles of St Paul [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fratres iam non estis hospites et advene sed estis cives sanctorum Ammonet illos ut memores sint beneficiorum dei quia cum longe essent a cognitione et timore dei
paratext: explicit: Fideles enim superficies sunt templi dei in spiritu conversantes ut possint heredes fieri celestis habitationis.
bibliography: bibl: In epistolam b. Pauli ad Ephesios, cap. II (PL 17.380B-381A)

work: standard title(s): Alcuin, 735–804: Commentary on John [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis creditis in deum et in me credite Ne mortem tanquam homines timerent et ideo turbarentur
paratext: explicit: ut glorificetur in patre et facit filius in patre ut pater glorificetur in filio quoniam unum sunt pater et filius.

paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis hec mando vobis ut diligatus invicem -
bibliography: bibl: See the Sermon in natale plurimorum apostolorum (no. 162)

paratext: incipit: Hierosolimis inventio sancte crucis ab helena regina sub constantino principe cuius ex ipsa extitit mater
paratext: explicit: ex aliis galeam nichilominus bello usibus aptam. Hic constituit aquam sparsionis cum sale benedici in habitaculis hominum et passionem domini miscuit in praecatione sacerdotum quando missa celebratur.
bibliography: bibl: D. V nonas maii MAII. (3 Maii.) (PL 123.256C-259A); Maius. Mensis Maii habet dies XXXI, lun. XXX (PL 131.1076A-B).

author: standard name(s): Ado, Saint, Archbishop of Vienne, approximately 800-875

work: standard title(s): Notker, Balbulus, approximately 840–912: Martyrologium [Latin]
bibliography: bibl: Maius. Mensis Maii habet dies XXXI, lun. XXX (PL 131.1076A-B).

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis ego si exaltatus fuero omnia traham post me Que omnia nisi ex quibus ille eicitur foras non autem dixit omnes sed omnia
paratext: explicit: Cum aliquid veri auditum habetis credite in veritatem ut renascamini in veritate.

work: standard title(s): Augustine, Saint, Bishop of Hippo: Sermons [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Factum est verbum domini ad me dicens priusquam te formarem in utero novi te Post illum sacrum domini natalem diem nativitatem nullius hominis legimus celebrari
paratext: explicit: Si in isto seculo ambulaverit in nobis in illo habitabit in nobis qui vivit et regnat deus in secula seculorum amen.

work: standard title(s): Bede, the Venerable, Saint, 673–735: Homiliae euangelii [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Fuit in diebus herodis regis sacerdos quidam nomine zacarias Venturus in carne dominus et redemptor noster multos dispensationis sue testes praemisit et nuntios
paratext: explicit: ipse donavit nos in vitam coronat eternam qui vivit et regnat cum patre in unitate spiritus sancti per infinita secula seculorum. Amen.

work: standard title(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819: Collectiones epistolarum et evangeliorum de tempore et de sanctis, siue Expositio libri comitis [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819
paratext: incipit: Hec dicit dominus deus audite insule et adtendite populi de longe Post vocationem ergo reliquiarum israel et abiectionem in incredulitate populi permanentis
paratext: explicit: Dominus pascit me et nichil mihi deerit in loco pascue ibi me collocavit super aquam refectionis educavit me.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Elisabeth impletum est tempus pariendi et peperit filium. Non solum opera et virtutes sanctorum plene sunt admirationibus sed etiam ipsa verba quibus ad memoriam posterorum
paratext: explicit: quod neque nos neque patres nostri portare potuimus sed per gratiam domini Jesu credimus salvari quemadmodum et illi.

work: standard title(s): Rabanus Maurus, Archbishop of Mainz, 784?–856: Homiliae in Evangelia et Epistolas [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Petrus et iohannes ascendebant in templum ad horam orationis nonam In lectione actuum apostolorum que nunc ob memoriam beatorum apostolorum lecta est
paratext: explicit: ut cum ipsis sanctis apostolis atque martyribus simulque cum omnibus sanctis eterne beatitudinis praemia consequatur.
bibliography: bibl: In vigilia sancti Petri apostoli. Lectio Actuum apostolorum (PL 110.347A-348C)

work: standard title(s): Bede, the Venerable, Saint, 673–735: Homiliae euangelii [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus petro symon iohannis diligis me plus hiis Virtutem nobis perfecte dilectionis praesens sancti evangelii lectio commendat
paratext: explicit: et se facta remunerare pollicetur Jesu Christo domino nostro qui vivit et regnat per omnia secula seculorum. Amen.

bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Iussit Jesus discipulos suos ascendere in naviculam et praecedere eum trans fretum Quod dicitur statim iussit discipulos ascendere in navem ostenditur quod illi inviti a domino separabantur
paratext: explicit: et apostoli viso miraculo repentine serenitatis post tempestatem venerunt et ad oraverunt eum dicentes vere dei filius es.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Fratres benedictus deus et pater domini nostri Jesu Christi qui benedixit nos in omni benedictione Docet nos et exhortatur apostolus fratres karissimi in laude Christi atque in benedictionem [sic!] quam accepimus a deo
paratext: explicit: ut praecibus eius adniti ad eternam gloriam illam que sanctis dei praeparata est pervenire possimus cui id est honor et gloria in secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Accesserunt ad Jesum iacobus et iohannes filii zeBeda Venerabilisi dicentes magister volumus Matheus scribit hanc matrem filiorum zeBeda Venerabilisi dominum postulasse pro illis

author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]

paratext: explicit: circa auditores suos impendebat qui dicebat. filioli mei quos iterum parturio donec formetur Christus in vobis.

paratext: incipit: Iussit Jesus discipulos suos ascendere in naviculam. -

paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis parabolam hanc homo quidam nobilis abiit in regionem longinquum accipere sibi regnum Homo nobilis ille est cui cecus supra clamat fili david miserere mei
paratext: explicit: Quibus quinque personis omne genus humanum quod in die iudicii futurum est exprimitur.

work: title: Epistola ad omnem ecclesiam. De revelatione corporis Stephani martyris primi et aliorum
work: standard title(s): Lucianus presbyter Caphamargalae, 5th century: Epistola de inventione corporis sancti Stephani martyris [Latin]

paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis ecce ego mitto vos sicut oves in medio luporum Exponit dominus quid sit apostolus. Apostolus enim grece latine missus interpretatur
paratext: explicit: Caput quidem cum cauda offerre est opus bonum usque ad perfectionem perducere.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Fratres qui parte seminat parce et metet Quia ad hoc hospitalitatem sectandam et elemosinarum virtutem paulus
paratext: explicit: Amen dico vobis super omnia bona sua constituet eum.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: explicit: ad quam nos adducere dignetur qui cum patre et spiritu sancto vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.

work: standard title(s): Augustine, Saint, Bishop of Hippo: Sermons [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Abest nobis dilectissimi optatus dies beate ac venerabilis semper virginis marie
paratext: explicit: Sit tibi assidue exorare pro populo dei que meruisti benedicta praecium proferre mundi qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.

paratext: incipit: Non omnibus requiem quesivi et in hereditate domini morabor Lectio huius capituli quod ex libro sapientie sumptum cognoscitur specialiter laudem eterni
paratext: explicit: Plentitudine enim habent qui in bonis operibus conversantur.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis Siquis venit ad me et non odit patrem suum Percunctari libet quomodo parentes et carnaliter propinquos

bibliography: bibl: In natali unius confessoris, evangelium Lucae, cap. XIV (PL 102.532B-534C)

paratext: incipit: Facta est contencio inter discipulos Jesu quis eorum videretur esse maior Sicut bonis esse moris solet in scripturis semper exempla

paratext: explicit: de morte sua natus est et de natali suo herodes mortuus est.

paratext: incipit: Heu me quid agam unum sermonis exordium faciam
paratext: explicit: herodias vero eidem caput abscidit et tanti viri mortem in precium saltationis accepit.

paratext: incipit: Misit herodes ac tenuit Johannem et iunxit eum in carcerem propter herodiadem uxorem Vetus quippe narrat hystoria philippum herodis filium

paratext: incipit: Liber generationis Jesu Christi filii david Praefacio tocius operius praemisit de quo dicturus erat
paratext: explicit: in qua gaudentes ab omni tristicia seculi liberati in eterna beatitudine regnabimus cum Christo. Amen.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: explicit: talis esse poterit anima magnificet dominum sicut anima marie magnificavit dominum.

paratext: incipit: Tempore illo postquam constantino augusto contra maxentium tyrannum properante

bibliography: bibl: Reversio sanctae atque gloriosissimae crucis Domini nostri Jesu Christi (PL 110.131D-134D)

work: standard title(s): Bede, the Venerable, Saint, 673–735: Commentary on Luke [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dicebat Jesus turbis phariseorum et principibus iudeorum ve vobis qui edificatis monumenta Non monumenta prophetarum ornare sed interfectores
paratext: explicit: non ipsi respicere sed doctorem veritatis insidiis moliuntur adgredi.

work: standard title(s): Bede, the Venerable, Saint, 673–735: Homiliae euangelii [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Vidit Jesus hominem sedentem in theloneo matheum nomine et ait illi sequere me Legimus apostolo dicente quia omnes peccaverunt et egent gloria dei
paratext: explicit: hoc meritus sed eius semper gratie tribuamus qui sedens in throno patris cum sancto spiritu vivit et regnat deus per omnia secula seculorum. Amen.

work: standard title(s): Rabanus Maurus, Archbishop of Mainz, 784?–856: Homiliae de festis praecipuis, item de virtutibus [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Memoriam beati archangeli michaelis toto orbo venerandam ipsius et opere condita
paratext: explicit: administratorii spiritus in ministerium missi propter eos qui hereditatem capiunt salutis in Christo Jesu domino nostro cui est honor et imperium in secula seculorum Amen.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]

paratext: explicit: exaudita sund verba tua et ego veni propter sermones tuos.

work: standard title(s): Bede, the Venerable, pseudo: Homilies [Latin]

paratext: explicit: non solum sanguinis effusione sed abstinentia peccorum et exercitatione dei praeceptorum perficitur.

paratext: incipit: Videns Jesus turbas ascendit in montem Predicante domino evangelium regni per universam iudeam
paratext: explicit: eo copiosiores a me coronas post finitos istius seculi labores accipietis.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]

paratext: explicit: neque differas de die in diem ne subito veniat ira eius et in tempore vindicte disperdat te.

work: standard title(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819: Collectiones epistolarum et evangeliorum de tempore et de sanctis, siue Expositio libri comitis [Latin]
author: standard name(s): Smaragdus, Abbot of St. Mihiel, active 809–819
paratext: incipit: Corde enim creditur ad iusticiam ore autem confessio fit ad salutem Qui vere et non falso confitetur ore dominum Jesum
paratext: explicit: Ad quos hos ergo tales non solum voces sed verba et rationem praevenisse pronuntiat.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]

paratext: explicit: ut per gratiam ipsius mereamur salvari quemadmodum et illi quod ipse praestare dignetur qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: bibl: In die celebri sancti Andreae apostoli (PL 118.747A-755C)

paratext: explicit: Sed quando dixit et glorificent patrem vestrum qui in celis est aperte demonstravit ut non nos sed dei in nostris laudetur operibus
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Beatus vir qui inventus est sine macula et qui post aurum non abiit In praesenti lectione audivimus quod beatus sit qui post aurum non abiit
paratext: explicit: Quod ipse praestare dignetur qui cum patre et spiritu sancto vivit et regnat deus in secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis nichil opertum quod non reveletur Nam multa abscondita sit in praesenti tempore
paratext: explicit: sed coram hominibus quia corde creditur ad iustitiam ore autem confessio fit ad salutem.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Iam non estis hospites et advene sed estis cives sanctorum et domestici dei Ergo iam non estis hospites et advene sive proseliti
paratext: explicit: ut sitis templum dei vivi sic crescendo de virtute in virtutem et hoc agite in spiritu sancto id est per gratiam sancti spiritus.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Scimus quoniam diligentibus domini omnia cooperantes in bonum Illi diligunt deum qui mandata eius custodiunt et servant
paratext: explicit: ut pro nobis traderet illum utique qui poterit in nobis ita implere.

work: standard title(s): Alcuin, 735–804: Commentary on John [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis hec mando vobis ut diligatis invicem Merito itaque magister bonus dilectionem sic sepe commendat
paratext: explicit: et propter nimiam cordis maliciam oderunt diligentem eos et benefacientem illis.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Respondens Jesus dixit confiteor tibi donime pater celi et terrae In fronte huius lectionis evangelice quaestio oritur cum nec superius nec inferius describatur
paratext: explicit: Regnum enim dei possidebunt beati oculi iustorum quibus dominus se et patrem revelare dignatus est.
bibliography: bibl: Sermo de confessione Jesu ad patrem, et de iugi eius suavitate et oneris levitate (PL 118.795B-797C)

paratext: incipit: Beatus homo qui invenit sapientiam et qui affluit predentia [sic!] Omni devocione et sollicitudine fratres carissimi verba lectionis quam audistis
paratext: explicit: nullus malus habebit sed omnis eam bonus sine dubio possidebit per eum qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Nemo militans deo implicat se negotiis secularibus ut ei placeat cui se probavit Cum beatus paulus apostolus celestem militiam ostenderet
paratext: explicit: qui utinam sic nos paratos inveniat ut ad eternam nos secum gloriam perducat Jesus Christus dominus noster qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis siquis vult post me venire abneget semetipsum Intimato dominus mysterio sue passionis ortatur apostolos ad sequendum
paratext: explicit: ecclesia per universam greciam et asyam et europam et pene per universum mundum dilataretur.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis nolite putare quia venerim pacem mittere in terram Super miserat dominus discipulos suos ad praedicandum dicens
paratext: explicit: potestas domini vero qui secreta cordis intuetur nequaquam vestra cogitatio latere potest.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

work: title: In epistolam ad Hebraeos, cap. XI-XII
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Sancti per fidem vicerunt regna qui per fidem pugnaverint et gentes plurimos vicerunt
paratext: explicit: ut patienter curramus sive expleamus certamen istud quatinus pervenire possimus ad promissum certaminis praemium.

work: standard title(s): Bede, the Venerable, pseudo: Homilies [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis cum audieritis proelia et seditiones nolite terreri Prelia ad hostes pertinent seditiones ad cives
paratext: explicit: spiritu principali confirmame quod in nobis perficiat qui vivit et gloriatur in secula seculorum Amen.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Descendens Jesus de monte stetit in loco campestri Non solum per mysterium incarnationis de celo in terram descendens dominus
paratext: explicit: Quia vero de mundo non estis sed ego elegi vos de mundo ideo odit vos mundus.

paratext: incipit: Ecce sacerdos magnus qui in diebus suis placuit deo et inventus est iustus et in tempore iracundie factus est reconciliatio Quamvis lectio ista quam nunc audistis fratres karissimi de aliquo terreno sacerdote
paratext: explicit: pro vobis orat id est ut veniam vobis omnium delictorum vestrorum concedat salvator mundi qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

work: title: In epistolam ad Hebraeos, cap. XIII
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Doctrinis variis et peregrinis nolite abduci Doctrine varie et peregrine nova dogmata sunt hereticorum quibus abducuntur et separantur
paratext: explicit: quod accepit. Tu enim terram dedisti ille celum reddet temporalia dedisti eterna mereberis.

work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Homiliae de tempore [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis parabolam hanc homo quidam peregre profici[s]cens vocavit servos suos In similitudinibus quas ad nostram ignorantiam instruendam dominus
paratext: explicit: ampliorem gratiam cum domino possidebit quanto largius talentum acceptum pro eius amore erogaverit.

paratext: incipit: Dixit Jesus discipulis suis vigilate quia nescitis qua hora dominus vester venturus sit Hic aperte ostenditur quare dominus diem iudicii superius ignorari dicat
paratext: explicit: Quo enim quisque amplius laboraverit eo ampliore mercede donabitur.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

work: title: In epistolam ad Hebraeos, cap. VII (PL 117.871A-872C); ?
work: standard title(s): Haimo, of Auxerre, -approximately 855: Commentary on St Paul's Epistles [Latin]
paratext: incipit: Plures facti sunt sacerdotes secundem legem idcirco quod morte prohiberentur Hic autem id est Jesus cui pater dixit cum iure iurando tu es sacerdos in eternum
paratext: explicit: cum Christo et angelis eius tempore migrationis tue perpetuum mereberis subire sacerdotium per eum qui vivit et gloriatur in secula seculorum. Amen.

paratext: incipit: Lingua sapientium ornat scientiam et os fatuorum ebullit stuliticiam in omni loco Doctrina iustorum et impiorum audistis in praesenti lectione fratres karissimi salomonem breviter tractantem
paratext: explicit: inter choros martyrum et confessorum vota gratiarum redemptori nostro reddere merebimur qui vivit et regnat in secula seculorum. Amen.
bibliography: note(s): Unidentified.

work: standard title(s): Bede, the Venerable, pseudo: Homilies [Latin]
